text:
priya: Quick sync — Q3 console/obs roadmap tradeoffs. We've got three competing asks: 1) 13mo retention for enterprise compliance, 2) per-tenant trace sampling + retention controls for customers generating heavy traces, 3) dashboard live-query perf improvements. Need prioritization and concrete launch criteria by EOD Wed.

josh: Can we get rough RICE-style inputs? Impact, effort, confidence. Also: Dedicated customers will push for SLA language — flagging that.

mike: For full 13mo retention across all telemetry we see ~3x storage. Big cost delta unless we limit to logs/dashboards. Per-tenant sampling is cheaper but requires routing + quotas.

anna: Engineering roughs: retention-tier backend + cold-store lifecycle ~6w core + 2w QA. Per-tenant sampling (config + routing + quota enforcement) ~4w. Live query perf (indexing/caching + infra) ~8–10w.

sam: From data side: traces drive most volume. If we limit 13mo to logs/dashboards (not raw traces) the storage is ~1.5x. We can offer retention tiers: standard(90d), extended(365d), archive(async retrieval) — archive retrieval can be 24–72h.

priya: Proposed prioritization: (A) per-tenant trace sampling + soft quota (MVP launch: sampling UI + backend enforcement + billing metric), (B) retention tiers for logs/dashboards with archive path, (C) live-query perf (big effort, deprioritize if timeline slips). Feedback?

alia: Customer input — two F500s asked specifically for 13mo for compliance. They are OK with archive cold retrieval window of 24–72h and an extra fee tier.

josh: Suggested launch criteria (examples): sampling: UI toggle + API + enforcement + cost telemetry; retention tiers: admin UI + policy API + billing metric + spot-check retrievals; perf: measurable p50/p95 improvement on live dashboards in staging. Also define rollback plan and SLOs.

mike: We should add a burst/fallback policy so a tenant can't blow up cluster costs. Prototype policy snippet: 

```
sampling_policy:
  default: 0.02
  tenant_overrides:
    tenant_id_xyz: 0.001
  burst_threshold: 10000/min
```

priya: Product ask: Can we scope a minimal retention MVP that gets enterprise sign-off: admin UI to set tenant retention tier + API + billing metric? Is that realistic as a short-scope delivery?

anna: Yes — minimal MVP: backend flag + admin UI + billing event emission + basic archive lifecycle job. If we reuse existing lifecycle code, estimate ~3w to ship MVP + 1w QA.

sam: I'll run storage sims for mixes (percent traces vs logs, percent on extended) and post numbers tomorrow. Also recommend we add a "retention_mismatch" alert if records are unexpectedly dropped >0.1%.

josh: Action items: anna — scope retention MVP with more detailed tasks & owners; mike — prototype sampling routing + cost sim; sam — storage simulation and alert thresholds; alia — gather exact customer SLA language and willingness to pay; priya — draft launch criteria doc and proposed pricing tiers by Tue.

priya: Timeline ask: prefer ship retention MVP + sampling MVP by end of Q3. If impossible, push live-query perf to Q4 and ship retention first.

anna: Ack. I'll put a Confluence doc with the retention MVP proposal and timelines and link here when ready.

priya: Thanks — tiny poll: react :thumbsup: if you agree with priority order A,B,C. Otherwise reply with objections.
